key_insight: VoroTypes enumerates the complete family of Voronoi cell topologies generated by small generic atomic perturbations, enabling structural identification of complex crystals.
engineering_relevance: It extends per-atom analysis in atomistic simulations to complex phases, including Frank–Kasper and Laves structures, with per-sublattice resolution.
method: Read a reference crystal structure from a CIF or POSCAR file.
Enumerate perturbed Voronoi topologies using exact symmetry reduction and validity pruning.
Export topological filters for use with VoroTop or OVITO.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a library of precomputed filters covering over 1,000 Materials Project structures, but provides no quantitative accuracy or runtime benchmarks.
watch_item: The enumeration covers small generic perturbations; robustness under large distortions or strongly disordered environments is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: VoroTypes: automated enumeration of Voronoi cell topologies for structural identification of complex crystals in atomistic simulations
